english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for giving up or damaging something valuable to achieve another goal.

examples.english: To finish the project, we have to sacrifice our weekend rest time.
examples.traditional: 為咗完成個計劃，我哋唯有犧牲周末嘅休息時間。
